reviewMethod: Actually independently read all 100 initial complete retained English/Chinese pairs, selected meanings and POS against every full frozen source field, every lexical-evidence field and every variant, in four untruncated 25-row ranges. Also read all 100 non-retained full frozen records; records 8-9 were explicitly reread after an output truncation, completing all 200 source records without approving author-deferred items. The actual canonical term/POS/Chinese/variant sets match all 200 frozen records, normalizing absent variants and empty arrays. This queue has published-Chinese-source-only evidence, not WordNet or automatic morphological equivalence. Individually checked actual head occurrence, applied natural use rather than definition/meta filler, register, source sense, technical type, POS realization and translation fidelity. Exact initial TSV snapshot is preserved in qa/b-original-read-p022.tsv and complete initial findings in qa/b-review-p022-findings.json. Following root-authorized author-only revision, actually reread all five final complete rows with all their frozen fields: adessive, aerodynamical, aerostatical, aerothermal and affectionated. Adessive now explicitly selects the already published adjective rather than relying on an ambiguous attributive noun reading; aerodynamical removes the invented team; aerostatical restores the engineer's possession of the notebook; aerothermal explicitly states flight vehicle; affectionated no longer invents whose disappointment it is. Independently verified that exactly these five rows changed, the other 95 complete rows are unchanged and all 100 terms/order are identical. All 100 final rows are acceptable after these resolved corrections. Final exact compiled-source hash is pinned and the mechanical signer verifies current LOCK/raw TSV equality and compiled entry equality; mechanical freshness checks are not language review.
